description: WebAuthn registration and authentication responses (attestation none and packed self) with expected outcomes. Binary values are base64url without padding. Challenges are single use and valid 300 seconds from challengeIssuedAtIso.

cases.name: register-none-es256
cases.description: Registration with attestation none, ES256 credential.

cases.name: register-packed-self-es256
cases.description: Registration with packed self attestation, ES256 credential.

cases.name: authenticate-es256
cases.description: Assertion for an ES256 credential, counter 5 to 6.

cases.name: register-none-rs256
cases.description: Registration with attestation none, RS256 credential.

cases.name: register-packed-self-rs256
cases.description: Registration with packed self attestation, RS256 credential.

cases.name: authenticate-rs256
cases.description: Assertion for an RS256 credential, counter 5 to 6.

cases.name: register-none-eddsa
cases.description: Registration with attestation none, EDDSA credential.

cases.name: register-packed-self-eddsa
cases.description: Registration with packed self attestation, EDDSA credential.

cases.name: authenticate-eddsa
cases.description: Assertion for an EDDSA credential, counter 5 to 6.

cases.name: authenticate-synced-passkey
cases.description: Backup eligible credential with backup state set.

cases.name: authenticate-counter-unsupported
cases.description: Authenticator without counter: 0 to 0 is not a clone signal.

cases.name: register-bad-origin
cases.description: clientDataJSON origin is not in the allowed list.

cases.name: authenticate-bad-origin
cases.description: Assertion from an origin that is not allowed.

cases.name: register-wrong-type
cases.description: Registration response with type webauthn.get.

cases.name: authenticate-wrong-type
cases.description: Assertion with type webauthn.create.

cases.name: register-uv-missing-biometric-policy
cases.description: Policy requires user verification, UV flag absent.

cases.name: authenticate-uv-missing-biometric-policy
cases.description: Policy requires user verification, UV flag absent.

cases.name: authenticate-uv-present-biometric-policy
cases.description: Policy requires user verification, UV flag present.

cases.name: authenticate-uv-absent-preferred-policy
cases.description: Policy prefers UV, absent flag is tolerated.

cases.name: authenticate-user-not-present
cases.description: UP flag not set.

cases.name: authenticate-counter-regression
cases.description: Counter did not increase: possible clone, policy fails closed.

cases.name: authenticate-counter-lower
cases.description: Counter went backwards.

cases.name: authenticate-counter-regression-tolerant-policy
cases.description: Same regression with failOnClone off: succeeds and reports cloneDetected.

cases.name: authenticate-bad-signature
cases.description: Last byte of the assertion signature flipped.

cases.name: authenticate-rp-id-hash-mismatch
cases.description: authenticatorData rpIdHash is for another RP.

cases.name: register-rp-id-hash-mismatch
cases.description: authenticatorData rpIdHash is for another RP.

cases.name: authenticate-unknown-credential
cases.description: Credential id is not registered.

cases.name: authenticate-user-handle-mismatch
cases.description: userHandle belongs to another user.

cases.name: authenticate-backup-eligibility-changed
cases.description: BE flag set but the stored credential is not backup eligible.

cases.name: register-challenge-mismatch
cases.description: Challenge in clientDataJSON was never issued.

cases.name: authenticate-challenge-mismatch
cases.description: Challenge in clientDataJSON was never issued.

cases.name: authenticate-challenge-expired
cases.description: Challenge issued 301 seconds ago, ttl is 300.

cases.name: register-packed-bad-signature
cases.description: Self attestation signature flipped.

cases.name: register-algorithm-not-allowed
cases.description: RS256 credential while the policy allows only ES256.
